mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fixture (season_id, round_no, home_team_id, away_team_id, kickoff_at, venue, status, home_score, away_score, data_locked, created_by) VALUES (#{seasonId}, #{roundNo}, #{homeTeamId}, #{awayTeamId}, #{kickoffAt}, #{venue}, #{status}, #{homeScore}, #{awayScore}, #{dataLocked}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fixture WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} AND status <> 'DRAFT' ORDER BY kickoff_at, id
SELECT * FROM fixture WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} ORDER BY kickoff_at, id
mapper.update: UPDATE fixture SET season_id = #{seasonId}, round_no = #{roundNo}, home_team_id = #{homeTeamId}, away_team_id = #{awayTeamId}, kickoff_at = #{kickoffAt}, venue = #{venue}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE fixture SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE fixture SET home_score = #{homeScore}, away_score = #{awayScore}, status = 'FINISHED', data_locked = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE fixture SET data_locked = #{locked}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fixture_event WHERE fixture_id = #{fixtureId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fixture_appearance WHERE fixture_id = #{fixtureId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fixture WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} AND (home_team_id = #{teamId} OR away_team_id = #{teamId})
